title.rendered: Container Offices for Sale in Hebbal, Bengaluru

content.rendered:
If you are looking at container offices for sale in Hebbal, buying factory-direct from the manufacturer keeps your cost and your timeline under control. SAMAN POS India Private Limited (SAMAN Portable) builds container offices at our Gopasandra, Bengaluru 560099 unit and delivers them ready-to-use across Hebbal and the wider Bengaluru region. Below is what we supply, how the units are built, and how to get a current quote for Hebbal.

Container Offices for Sale in Hebbal

A container office is a steel office cabin built on an MS steel frame and finished at our factory, then transported to your Hebbal site as a complete unit. SAMAN Portable supplies 10ft, 20ft and 40ft container offices for businesses around Hebbal — site offices, sales and project rooms, security posts and back-office space — delivered fully built so you can occupy them within days of installation.

Container office sizes we supply

We build three standard footprints. Each can be specified as a plain office shell or fitted with extra windows, partitions, electricals, flooring and an AC point. Layouts can be adjusted to your requirement at the order stage.

Size Typical use Common fit-out
10ft Security cabin, single-desk site office, guard or supervisor post 1 door, 1–2 windows, light point, fan/AC point
20ft Project office, sales office, 3–5 person workspace Door, windows, partition option, multiple power points, AC-ready
40ft Larger team office, dual cabin, office-plus-store layout Internal partitions, multiple windows, full electricals, AC-ready

Units can be placed singly or combined and stacked where the site allows, so you can scale the workspace as your Hebbal operation grows. For full specifications and the current range, see our container office collection.

Why buy your container office direct from SAMAN

SAMAN Portable is a manufacturer, not a reseller or listing site, so the unit you order is built in our own factory and quality-checked before dispatch. Buying direct means one point of accountability for build quality, delivery and after-sales support.

  • Steel built to standard: every container office uses an MS steel frame fabricated to IS 2062, the structural steel standard, for a rigid, transportable, long-lasting unit.
  • Factory-built quality: manufactured at our Gopasandra, Bengaluru 560099 unit under our ISO 9001:2015 certified quality system.
  • Warranty: 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. (The 20–25 years is the engineered service life of the structure, not a warranty period.)
  • Clear delivery terms: delivery from ₹3,000, with typical transit of 3–5 days to Bengaluru sites, and returns accepted within 7 days of delivery or installation.

Delivery and installation in Hebbal

We deliver across Bengaluru, and Hebbal is well within our regular dispatch area from the Gopasandra unit. Your container office leaves the factory as a finished unit, so site work is minimal — the cabin is positioned, levelled and made ready for use. Typical transit time is 3–5 days once the order and site details are confirmed, with delivery from ₹3,000. Please make sure the delivery point has clear vehicle access and a firm, level base for placement.

Get a container office quote in Hebbal

Tell us the size you need (10ft, 20ft or 40ft), your fit-out — windows, partitions, electricals, flooring, AC — and your Hebbal delivery location, and we will share a current price and lead time. Pricing depends on size and specification, so we quote each unit on enquiry rather than publishing a fixed rate. To order or get a quote, Call +91 88616 22859 or use Send Enquiry on the site, or browse the container office range to start your request.

FAQs


What sizes of container office can I buy for Hebbal?

We supply 10ft, 20ft and 40ft container offices. The 10ft suits a security or single-desk cabin, the 20ft a small team or project office, and the 40ft a larger team or combined office-and-store layout. Units can be combined or stacked where the site allows.


How long does delivery to Hebbal take?

Typical transit is 3–5 days once your order and site details are confirmed. Delivery starts from ₹3,000. The cabin arrives as a finished unit, so it is ready to use shortly after it is positioned and levelled on site.


Can the container office be customised?

Yes. You can specify windows, internal partitions, electrical points, flooring and an AC point, and adjust the layout to suit your use. Share your requirement when you enquire and we will build the unit to match.


What warranty do you provide?

5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. The 20–25 years describes the engineered service life of the structure, not a warranty period.


What is the price of a container office in Hebbal?

Price depends on the size and how the unit is fitted out, so we quote each one on enquiry rather than listing a fixed rate. Call +91 88616 22859 or use Send Enquiry with your size and specification for a current quote.


How do I order a container office for Hebbal?

Call +91 88616 22859 or use Send Enquiry with your size, fit-out and Hebbal delivery address. We confirm the specification, price and lead time, then build and deliver the finished unit to your site.
